sentences: When naming function argument variables, I want you to end the names with '_a'.
We'll touch base regularly to ensure you're settling in well and to discuss any questions or issues you might have.
Don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything at all.
Jacob, I want to emphasize the importance of including try statements in your functions, especially when you're working with error-prone operations or external dependencies.
This is a crucial aspect of defensive programming and will help ensure that your code is robust and can handle potential exceptions gracefully.
By doing so, you're not only making your code more resilient but also providing clear feedback to users when something goes wrong.
It's a best practice that will serve you well, especially in a production environment where stability and user experience are key concerns.
As your mentor, it's my role to guide you towards becoming a skilled and proficient engineer.
Keep up the good work, and don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns.
